 1          Pursuant to Civil L.R. 6-1(a), Plaintiff Oliver Tsuya (“Plaintiff”) and Defendants Plex, Inc.
 2   and Plex GmbH (collectively, “Defendants”) (together, the “Parties”), through their undersigned
 3   counsel, hereby stipulate and agree as follows:
 4          1.      WHEREAS, Plaintiff filed his Complaint on December 16, 2024, claiming that
 5   Defendants' alleged refusal to pay JAMS' arbitration fees is a breach of Defendants' arbitration
 6   agreement and a violation of the California Unfair Competition Law (ECF No. 1).
 7          2.      WHEREAS, Defendants filed a Motion to Dismiss on January 6, 2025 (ECF No. 17).
 8          3.      WHEREAS, the Court issued an Order on February 24, 2025, temporarily staying the
 9   above-captioned matter until April 29, 2025 to "provide JAMS an opportunity to inform the [P]arties
10   whether and when the arbitration proceedings will be suspended or terminated if [Defendants]
11   maintain [their] apparent refusal to pay the arbitration filings fees." (ECF No. 25).
12          4.      WHEREAS, the Court issued an Order on May 2, 2025, requesting the Parties file
13   supplemental briefing regarding the Defendants' Motion to Dismiss "to account for the developments
14   in the arbitration proceedings." (ECF No. 29).
15          5.      WHEREAS, the court issued an Order (ECF No. 30) on May 6, 2025, staying the
16   action and requesting the Parties file a Joint Status Report by June 20, 2025, (ECF No. 31) if the
17   Parties had not dismissed the action.
18          6.      WHEREAS, Parties are currently drafting a settlement agreement and are committed
19   to executing in the near future, and filing a request for dismissal of the entire action with prejudice.
20          NOW WHEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY STIPULATED BY AND BETWEEN THE PARTIES
21   THAT, subject to the Court’s approval, this matter be stayed and all forthcoming deadlines suspended
22   for forty-five (45) days from June 19, 2025 to August 3, 2025. Doing so, will conserve the Court’s
23   resources and allow the Parties to execute a settlement agreement and file the request for dismissal of
24   the entire action with prejudice.
